LanguageData.sw_DeadSarlaccCave.label: a dead sarlacc
LanguageData.sw_DeadSarlaccCave.description: This area hosts a dead sarlacc creature. These sessile creatures are known to have millenia long lifespans, but are ultimately mortal. Whether from disease, starvation, burrowing insectoids or even old age they eventually die and leave a cavern where the bulk of their corpse has rotted away.
LanguageData.sw_SarlaccLair.label: sarlacc pit
LanguageData.sw_SarlaccLair.description: This area hosts a juvenile sarlacc creature. These sessile creatures are known to have millenia long lifespans, the circular maws on the surface are supported by a massive undergorund body.
